page_structure.tab: Allows users to upload PKL files and optionally a manifest.json configuration. Shows file drop zone, manifest preview, and pipeline progress tracking. Displays current portal state before upload begins. Supports file-by-file progress and overall pipeline progress monitoring.

Displays table of past executions with status (completed/failed), data as of date, files processed, duration, and triggered by info. Supports rollback to previous execution state. Shows informational panel about rollback mechanics.

architecture_notes.note: State is managed by useDataRefreshState hook which handles file uploads, manifest parsing, S3 presigned URL coordination, pipeline triggering, status polling, and history fetching. Uses XMLHttpRequest for direct S3 uploads with progress tracking.

Pipeline status is polled every 3 seconds until a terminal state is reached (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, ABORTED). Polling is cleaned up on unmount. Frontend handles 409 Conflict errors (pipeline already running) with retry scheduling.

manifest.json is parsed synchronously in FileDropZone and again during upload. Manifest contains file type mappings (data_pkl, model_pkl, etc) that determine which generators will run. Missing file detection provides UX warnings.

PipelineProgress groups individual Step Functions steps by phase (Setup & Validation, Data Ingestion, Generate JSON, Update Portal, Finalize) for cleaner UI. Groups are collapsible with auto-expand on active step.

409 Conflict errors trigger special handling with user-friendly toast suggesting retry after timeout. Other errors show generic failure message. Failed pipeline states show AWS Step Functions console link.
CurrentStatePanel reads /api/general/json/latest/manifest.json to display current portal state, data as of dates for each source, and staleness indicators (Fresh/Aging/Stale based on age).
